Exact crop/page govern action; accepted portrait gives same-instant identity and hand/rib state. Same olive/hazel face, loose raised dark curls, crystals, ivory-gold wrap/trousers/belt. Only the first small local gold arc/filaments around contact, no second support/bridge. Navy seats and seated passengers stay behind her. All working fingers and face visible; no simple crop/padding of portrait. Preserve source pose, no new event. Quiet roof pocket upper-left for one later short bubble, away from passenger faces. Painterly semi-realistic graphic novel, warm light and cool seats. Absolutely no text, bubbles, SFX, border or watermark.
